# Vibe-Coding Center

> 31 instruction-only skills: 4 featured guides and 27 reusable workflows.

Read AGENT_GUIDE.md when the user asks to create or use a VCC skill. Select the skill matching the task. Follow the user's project instructions and existing authorization.

## Agent entry points

- [Agent directions](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/AGENT_GUIDE.md): selection, creation, validation, and use.
- [Structured directory](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/agent-skills.json): names, descriptions, sources, guides, and skill URLs.
- [All skill files](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/downloads/vcc-agent-skills.zip): 31 local skill folders; no executable installer.

## Featured guides

- [Web design](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/agent-skills/vcc-web-design/SKILL.md): `vcc-web-design`. [Readable guide](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/guides/design.html).
- [SecureVCC](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/agent-skills/securevcc/SKILL.md): `securevcc`. [Readable guide](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/guides/security.html).
- [Education privacy](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/agent-skills/edu-compliance/SKILL.md): `edu-compliance`. [Readable guide](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/guides/education.html).
- [Vibe-Code Rescue](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/agent-skills/vibe-code-rescue/SKILL.md): `vibe-code-rescue`. [Readable guide](https://mguhlin.github.io/vcc/guides/rescue.html).
